<p>One by one, Earth's greatest fighters have fallen to an alien Predator. A tournament has become a burial ground, and only three competitors are left standing — barely. In this blood-soaked final issue, Abigail, Sara and Kai make a desperate bid to escape the Garden. But first, they have to face off against the Predator one last time.
